# SMAA

`AreaTex.png` and `SearchTex.png` are the precomputed tables of SMAA (Enhanced Subpixel
Morphological Antialiasing) by Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Belen Masia, Fernando Navarro
and Diego Gutierrez, under the license in `LICENSE.txt`. `SmaaTextures.cpp` holds the same PNG
bytes for the engine to decode at start.
